scope: Every one of the 26 declared allocator-demo snapshot fields. These are owner observations, not API authority, admission, RSS or the complete demo protocol inventory. A real source model maps each runtime field directly; source strings preserve actual lifecycle/model enum names.
consistency: Mapping operates on one captured value, never recapturing runtime state field by field. Source capture retains its model-specific owner-thread/gate/fast-lane contract; exact comparison with other snapshots requires quiescence or a stable entered callback. Mapping and serialization create no stronger atomicity guarantee.
resetPolicy: Mapping and JSON serialization reset nothing. Owner identities and real peaks survive recycle, generation changes and native cleanup. MetricsEpoch follows actual process-accounting reset, independently of owner histories. No derived snapshot reconstructs historical peaks or saturated counters.
availability: Available is false only for caller-default Unspecified model; every remaining nullable field is then null, including numeric fields that could otherwise be measured zero. Real absent model-specific banks report verified numeric zero/false. Neither available terminal telemetry nor a positive identity grants fresh borrowing authority.
unreviewedScope: The remaining demo configuration/measurement/report/OS/payload roles, full public API and lifecycle inventory, all feature performance and diagnostic enabled/disabled cost evidence, final native matrix, shipping symbols, complete review and publication remain mandatory. This exact mapping proof cannot be relabeled a complete release inventory.

fields.name: Available
fields.units: boolean
fields.definition: A supplied runtime owner snapshot has a specified model; false for Unspecified/default, with all other fields unavailable rather than fake zero.
fields.overflow: Actual finite model check; never inferred from byte count.

fields.name: Lifecycle
fields.units: owner gate enum name or null
fields.definition: Actual active, returned, unleased or disposed source gate. Numeric terminal capture cannot restore renting authority.
fields.overflow: Copies a finite actual source state, null when unavailable.

fields.name: Generation
fields.units: model-specific generation identity or null
fields.definition: Actual source current/most recent generation, not fabricated from address or metrics epoch. Fast pool true zero is not an unavailable generation.
fields.overflow: Source checked identity admission and fast signed-bit representation are preserved unchanged.

fields.name: ScopeEpoch
fields.units: model-specific scope identity or null
fields.definition: Actual source scoped-lifetime identity. Recycle changes the real epoch; bank absence/current-generation absence retains its defined zero.
fields.overflow: Source checked identity and fast UInt64 signed-bit representation copied, no reclassification.

fields.name: MetricsEpoch
fields.units: process measurement identity or null
fields.definition: Actual process accounting measurement epoch; resetting this does not erase owner peaks or change owner identity.
fields.overflow: Source checked non-reusing epoch copied, zero is valid initial state.

fields.name: ActiveRecords
fields.units: current metadata records or null
fields.definition: Actual allocation/materialized/compact/grouped metadata records, not every logical fast bump range. Rooted ordinary and scoped allocations have real records; thread-confined bump model has none.
fields.overflow: Copies checked source record sum without adding aliases.

fields.name: ScopedRecords
fields.units: current scoped metadata records or null
fields.definition: Actual scoped allocation/materialized/grouped records; recycle removes their authority without inventing physical release. Fast bump has a genuine zero record-table invariant.
fields.overflow: Copies checked source scoped subset.

fields.name: ReferenceRoots
fields.units: current nonnull payload roots or null
fields.definition: Actual roots in native reference-slot storage; ordinary plus scoped rooted payload has two. Unmanaged fast payload genuinely has none, and recycle debits scoped roots.
fields.overflow: Copies bounded root-table count, not control-object references.

fields.name: OrdinaryTraversalIndex
fields.units: source bank index/frontier or null
fields.definition: Actual ordinary candidate/search frontier under the source model. Minus one is an absent-lane sentinel, not unavailable null. No conversion to occupied-segment claim.
fields.overflow: Copies source checked/bank-bounded index and sentinel unchanged.

fields.name: ScopedTraversalIndex
fields.units: source bank index/frontier or null
fields.definition: Actual scoped candidate/reverse frontier, including minus-one sentinel; absent scope is never substituted occupied segment zero.
fields.overflow: Copies source bounded index and sentinel unchanged.

fields.name: RetainedSegmentCount
fields.units: current physical storage segments or null
fields.definition: Actual current slabs/whole pages/bump segments including attached external segments; not metadata/live lease count. Native cleanup reaches measured zero.
fields.overflow: Copies checked source bank count, no independently summed aliases.

fields.name: AvailableSegmentCount
fields.units: completely idle reusable segments or null
fields.definition: Actual reusable current segments, not partial slack. Reset creates idle availability; a closed detached owner has zero availability despite still charged bytes.
fields.overflow: Copies exact source subset, never inferred from retained bytes.

fields.name: RetiredGenerationCount
fields.units: generations awaiting drain or null
fields.definition: Actual entered-use-retired bank excluding quarantined generations. Failed drain moves one generation from retirement to quarantine, not free.
fields.overflow: Copies bounded source bank count; fast owner absent bank is real zero.

fields.name: RetiredSegmentCount
fields.units: retired and quarantined segments or null
fields.definition: Actual combined old-bank physical segment count. QuarantinedSegmentCount is an overlapping subset, not extra storage.
fields.overflow: Copies checked old-bank source sum.

fields.name: RetiredBytes
fields.units: retired/quarantined owned native extent bytes or null
fields.definition: Actual complete owned extent in old banks, still included in OutstandingNativeBytes and budget charge; excludes borrowed provider payload and cannot be credited as free.
fields.overflow: Copies checked physical source sum independent of history saturation.

fields.name: QuarantinedGenerationCount
fields.units: failed-drain generations or null
fields.definition: Actual ended-generation quarantine bank, not the healthy current generation. Nonzero after a real cleanup-boundary failure, zero after physical disposal.
fields.overflow: Copies bounded source quarantine bank count.

fields.name: QuarantinedSegmentCount
fields.units: failed-drain segments or null
fields.definition: Actual storage held by ended quarantined generations, overlapping RetiredSegmentCount and still fully charged.
fields.overflow: Copies checked source quarantine sum.

fields.name: CurrentGenerationQuarantined
fields.units: actual current-generation boolean or null
fields.definition: Copies the actual current-generation flag. Normal failed drain quarantines an ENDED generation, so its healthy replacement stays false even with nonzero old quarantine. Fast owners have no quarantine mechanism; no test invents a current quarantine state by mutating its flag.
fields.overflow: Actual boolean/current-absence invariant, not inferred from old bank count.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.units: stable process-local lineage or null
fields.definition: Actual positive source identity, unchanged across recycle/metrics reset/closure. It is not an address or permission to borrow.
fields.overflow: Source checked positive identity admission; mapping never allocates a new identity.

fields.name: Model
fields.units: actual owner storage-model enum name or null
fields.definition: Actual thread-confined or synchronized model explaining genuine absent banks. Unspecified maps the entire unsupported observation to unavailable, not fake model-specific zero.
fields.overflow: Finite immutable source enum copied; default is unavailable.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.units: sticky history-saturation boolean or null
fields.definition: Real source history overflow, not reconstructed from a current gauge. A true value survives trim/metrics reset/cleanup while physical accounting stays exact.
fields.overflow: Source sticky saturation copied, no checked conversion or accounting suppression.

fields.name: OutstandingNativeBytes
fields.units: currently owned known native extent bytes or null
fields.definition: Actual owner-acquired complete extent including known header/padding and old/detached banks. Not RSS; overlap categories are not added again. Physical native cleanup reaches zero.
fields.overflow: Copies exact checked physical gauge, unaffected by saturated completed histories.

fields.name: DetachedNativeBytes
fields.units: GC-detached owned extent bytes or null
fields.definition: Actual outstanding subset assigned to eventual finalization. Disposal does not pretend this storage freed; the surviving kernel remains charged while physically present.
fields.overflow: Copies checked actual subset at real detach/free boundaries.

fields.name: PeakOutstandingNativeBytes
fields.units: owner lifetime high-water native extent bytes or null
fields.definition: Recorded actual peak acquisition, not inferred from current storage or copied from a shared domain. It survives metrics reset and physical cleanup.
fields.overflow: Copies maximum of checked physical source gauge, no reconstruction.

fields.name: InitializedPayloadBytes
fields.units: currently initialized logical bytes or null
fields.definition: Actual initialized live source demand, not padding, reserved capacity or snapshot aliases. Recycle/reset removes logical visibility without pretending a free.
fields.overflow: Copies checked current initialized gauge distinct from backing.

fields.name: PeakInitializedPayloadBytes
fields.units: owner lifetime initialized-byte high water or null
fields.definition: Actually recorded successful initialized demand, unchanged after logical reset and physical disposal. Failed unpublished initialization is not successful demand.
fields.overflow: Copies source recorded maximum of checked initialized gauge.
